title: Safety and confidence engine
purpose: Make confidence a first-class domain value and guarantee that no output implies a safety guarantee the system cannot provide.
architecturalScope: Safety bounded context. ConfidenceFusion and SafetySupervisor, sitting between all capability outputs and user-facing output.
domainContext: Confidence, ConfidenceScore, Observation, Uncertainty, Obstacle, ObstacleDetected. Low confidence leads to STOP, reacquire, reassess.

milestones.title: Confidence model and thresholds
milestones.description: Confidence is carried through the system and thresholds are configurable.

milestones.title: Safety supervisor and phrasing guard
milestones.description: Every outgoing message is reviewed and downgraded when uncertain.

tasks.title: Define Confidence value object and Observation contract
acceptanceCriteria: No result type exists without confidence.

tasks.title: Implement confidence fusion and threshold policy
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover stale and contradictory observations.

tasks.title: Implement SafetySupervisor phrasing guard
acceptanceCriteria: Obstacle hints are always marked uncertain.
Confidence remains available throughout the pipeline (AGENTS.md 20).
A test proves guarantee phrasing cannot be emitted.

risks.mitigation: Consistent uncertainty language and non-guarantee messaging.

risks.description: Confidence values are uncalibrated and meaningless.

safetyImplications: This is the primary safety boundary of the system and must have the strictest tests.
accessibilityImplications: Uncertainty must be audible, not only visual.
privacyImplications: Safety audit logs are ephemeral and local by default.
verificationRequirements: Fuzzing of the dialog logic for uncertainty handling.

decisionLog.decision: MVP ships todo.mvp-safety-confidence as a minimal subset; the full engine remains a later extension.
